rationale: Sam's work on tooling and systems for autonomous vehicle development at Applied Intuition complements Harsh's robotics systems engineering background, where both are bridging complex software integration with real-world autonomous systems. While Sam focuses on the AV stack and Harsh on intelligent manipulation and robotics, there's meaningful overlap in autonomous-systems domain expertise and potential for cross-pollination on how tooling, simulation, or deployment challenges translate across these adjacent areas.
intro_message: Sam Morstein, meet Harsh Dhruva — you're both building infrastructure for autonomous systems (AV tooling vs. robotics manipulation), and your experience integrating software with hardware-heavy problems could spark useful conversation.
